channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Terry Stotts | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Terry Stotts from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Terry Stotts
item.description:
Olshey on the decision to move on from Stotts:

“We felt we had reached a ceiling. It was not an easy decision. ... We lost in the first round to a team that was missing an All-Star point guard and probably two of their top five players. We felt we had plateaued.”

Neil Olshey on Terry Stotts, Jun 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, Terry Stotts
item.description:
“We had some elite grapes there. One night, Dame [Damian Lillard], Melo [Carmelo Anthony], Terry [Stotts, the Blazers’ head coach] and our trainer Geoff Clark had some heavy hitters over dinner, including a 2014 Screaming Eagle.”

CJ McCollum on Carmelo Anthony, Damian Lillard, Terry Stotts, Apr 24, 2021. Source: Robb Report.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Terry Stotts
item.description:
“Coach Terry [Stotts] likes a lot of different cabs, so he orders the cabs, I order the different Oregon Pinots, then Geoff Clark, the head trainer, he orders a lot of different wines so we have a nice little system going.”

CJ McCollum on Terry Stotts, Jun 26, 2020. Source: KOIN.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on Terry Stotts
item.description:
Kanter signed with the Blazers on Feb. 13, seven days after being waived by the Knicks.

“I remember the first two or three games … I would never really get a compliment about my defense, but he (Stotts) was like ‘that’s good defense,’”

Enes Kanter Freedom on Terry Stotts, Jun 1, 2019. Source: The Oklahoman.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Paul Allen, Bert Kolde, Terry Stotts, Chris McGowan
item.description:
“I am honored to extend my tenure with the Portland Trail Blazers under the leadership of Jody Allen, the ongoing partnership with Bert Kolde, Chris McGowan and Terry Stotts and in the memory of Paul G. Allen,”

Neil Olshey on Paul Allen, Bert Kolde, Terry Stotts, Chris McGowan, May 24, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Michael Malone on Terry Stotts, Jusuf Nurkic
item.description:
Michael Malone on Jusuf Nurkic:

“You never want to see that happen, but for a guy that was a part of our family, I reached out to Terry Stotts. I feel awful for Jusuf. And hopefully that team can bounce back.”

Michael Malone on Terry Stotts, Jusuf Nurkic, Mar 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Terry Stotts
item.description:
CJ McCollum on coach Terry Stotts:

“I think he’s done a terrific job with what he’s been given.”

CJ McCollum on Terry Stotts, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @BlazerFreeman.

item.title: Jusuf Nurkic on Terry Stotts
item.description:
Joe Freeman:Nurkic on Stotts:

“I think, overall, very positive. I love Stotts and enjoy playing for him... I think he’s a great communicator. But I feel even he didn’t expect to lose 4-0 in the playoffs, which sometimes can be tough. People don’t understand that can be part of the life.”

Jusuf Nurkic on Terry Stotts, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @BlazerFreeman.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Terry Stotts
item.description:
Houston coach Mike D’Antoni on the #Blazers

“Terry (Stotts) does a great job every year. The 2nd halves of their seasons are unbelievable. I’m going to have to ask him what he does in the 2nd half (of each season). They’re making a great run. We’ll have our hands full tonight.”

Mike D'Antoni on Terry Stotts, Mar 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Terry Stotts
item.description:
“Everybody that has somethin (sic) to say about coach Stotts doesn't know a damn thing about what it takes to win a close game,”

Damian Lillard on Terry Stotts, Nov 19, 2017. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Damian Lillard on LeBron James, Terry Stotts
item.description:
Damian Lillard:

“I’m thankful to the Trail Blazers’ organization and Coach Stotts for giving me the opportunity and the freedom to go out there and accomplish something like this. Just looking at it being a list of Hall of Famers and LeBron (James) being the only active player to accomplish something like that, obviously it’s great company.”

Damian Lillard on LeBron James, Terry Stotts, Jan 30, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: George Karl on Damian Lillard, Terry Stotts
item.description:
George Karl:

“I was watching the Portland Trailblazers play, and I was trying to figure out, ‘What the hell is wrong with this team?’ My conclusion is that Damian Lillard is getting too much attention….Who controls the team? The coach and the point guard. And that team is not working. I think their coach, Terry Stotts, is a great coach. So I’m going to say the problem is Lillard. They were a together, connected, committed team last year. This year they’re not. What changed?”

George Karl on Damian Lillard, Terry Stotts, Dec 29, 2016. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Terry Stotts
item.description:
Joe Freeman:Neil Olshey on Terry Stotts' extension:

“We got it done as fast as possible so he could get some sunshine in Palm Springs.”

Neil Olshey on Terry Stotts, May 17, 2016. Source: Twitter.

item.title: LeBron James on Terry Stotts
item.description:
“Even though he wasn't on the team, he's an All-Star. C.J. obviously is a stud being from here, the Canton area. Of course he's a stud. I thought Terry Stotts did a great job. They had a great season.”

LeBron James on Terry Stotts, May 12, 2016. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Terry Stotts
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on the rebuilding Trail Blazers' success:

“I know how great a coach Terry [Stotts] is, so I'm not surprised. I think he's the frontrunner for Coach of the Year because of how they've progressed. If I had a vote, that's who I'd vote for.”

Rick Carlisle on Terry Stotts, Mar 20, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Terry Stotts
item.description:
“It meant a lot. I almost went over there and patted (Stotts) on the back at the end of the game to let him know, we with you,”

Damian Lillard on Terry Stotts, Oct 23, 2015. Source: Forward Center.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Terry Stotts
item.description:
One thing the Blazers won't see in the offseason, Olshey says, is a coaching change.

“(Stotts) has just won 54 and 51 games (the past two regular seasons), and (the coaching staff) did a great job developing our guys,”

Neil Olshey on Terry Stotts, May 2, 2015. Source: Portland Tribune.

item.title: Chris Kaman on Mike Dunleavy, Terry Stotts
item.description:
Jason Quick:Chris Kaman:

“I just told Terry (Stotts) he is the first coach I haven't hated at the end of the season since Mike Dunleavy. Long time.”

Chris Kaman on Mike Dunleavy, Terry Stotts, May 1, 2015. Source: Twitter @jwquick.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Terry Stotts
item.description:
Damian Lillard told CSNWW.com.

“I love coach Stotts. That’s the coach. I think when the boat starts to rock a little bit, that’s when everybody is, ‘Uh oh. What’s going on with the coaches and the players? Why are they losing games?’ It’s tough, but our group is still here. We’re staying together.”

Damian Lillard on Terry Stotts, Mar 28, 2014. Source: CSNNW.com.

item.title: Wesley Matthews on Terry Stotts
item.description:
“I thought Kaleb was definitely going to get that job. But after talking to Neil and hearing his reasons, I’m excited. Coach Stotts brings championship experience and I think that’s huge. That’s somewhere we see ourselves in the near-near future.”

Wesley Matthews on Terry Stotts, Aug 8, 2012. Source: Oregonian.
